{{Quote|A group of operatives is currently preparing to locate and detain Antig, as he has recently been sighted in the Ethav Regions without his crew or the ''Trustworthy''.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="Journal10">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>}}
The '''Ethav Regions''' were a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It contained the [[Ethav Major system/Legends|Ethav Major system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Journal10" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Drolen Antig]] was sighted in the Ethav Regions without his [[Etti Lighter|freighter]], the [[Trustworthy (freighter)|''Trustworthy'']], or his crew. That fact was noted by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] within the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'' in an entry dedicated to Antig.<ref name="Journal10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ethav Regions were introduced by [[Craig Robert Carey]] within the "[[Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)|Wanted by Cracken]]" feature of [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]] in [[May]] [[1996]].<ref name="Journal10" />  The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Ethav Major [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square P-3.<ref name="TEA" />
